title: Original v1.0 plane and actor drawing

coverage_exempt.reason: The same ECX count was proven positive before the first plane pointer is read; no call or write intervenes before this repeated count test.
Index starts at one and enters only below the unchanged signed count; no call occurs between that guard and these repeated bounds tests. The bounded loop cannot overflow its index.

A callback may invalidate the current plane index, but this null-plane selection immediately enters drawTiles with receiver zero and dereferences unmapped address +8. Guest memory faults are outside returning comparison cases.

Out-of-range frame selection sets the frame pointer to zero and immediately dereferences unmapped frame+0x28/+0x2c. No returning case can reach this instruction with valid guest memory; native safety faults are not original successful returns.

notes: The canonical module is independent of Sources/PlaneRenderer.cpp and Sources/PlaneRenderer.h; those legacy APIs remain preserved for existing app callers. All four legacy original entry points remain owned.
